notes.title: New Objective UI & Bug Fixes Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!



After the last update where I introduced the new tutorial, I felt that the power objectives were still a bit underwhelming and needed clearer feedback.



That’s why this update brings a new UI notification system: now, when you complete a power objective, the game will show you that progress directly, making your actions feel more impactful and rewarding.



On top of that, I’ve also fixed two important bugs related to the switches:

After the tutorial, it was impossible to complete the switches objective, this has now been resolved.

The switches monitor was always showing Yellow as Off and Red as On, regardless of the real state. This has also been fixed.



Thank you so much for all the feedback and support, every small update helps me make Haunted Mines a better experience!

– Sergio (XereonDev)
